units.source_text: 源氏公子回到邸内，不能立刻就寝。

en.t: Prince Genji returned to his residence, but could not go to sleep at once.

units.source_text: 他想：“再度相逢是不可能的了。

en.t: He thought, "It will be impossible to meet her again.

units.source_text: 但不知此人现在作何感想？”

en.t: But I wonder what she is feeling now."
At that, he felt dejected at heart.

units.source_text: 又想起那天的雨夜品评，觉得这个人并不特别优越，

en.t: He also recalled the judgments made on that rainy night, and felt that this woman was not especially superior,

units.source_text: 却也风韵娴雅，无疵可指，该是属于中品的。

en.t: yet she had a graceful and refined charm, with no fault to point out, and surely belonged to the middle rank.

units.source_text: 那个见多识广的左马头的话，确有道理。

en.t: The words of that well informed and experienced Captain of the Left Division of the Stables were indeed reasonable.
